items.title: Directions:
items.text: INSTRUCTIONS: IMPRESSIVE NOISE REDUCTION - The Quiet 2 offers up to 24dB (SNR) noise reduction. Simply insert the earplugs into your ear and twist them for a secure fit. The flexible silicone ear plugs not only dampen annoying noise, but also offer an ultra-comfortable fit and stylish design. Wherever you are, escape to your own quiet world and experience better sleep, highest concentration, stress-free travel and much more. The Quiet 2 earplugs provide certified hearing protection that protects your ears from harmful sounds.

features: POWERFUL NOISE REDUCTION – Packing up to 24 dB (SNR) of noise reduction into a flexible silicone earplug, Quiet 2 muffles unwanted noise in comfort and style. Get in your quiet bubble anywhere for improved sleep, deep focus, stress-free travel and beyond. Quiet 2 earplugs qualify as certified hearing protection to keep your ears safe from damaging sounds.

ULTRA-COMFY FIT – Made from lightweight, flexible silicone, these reusable earplugs offer dreamy comfort day and night, even for side-sleepers. Comes with 4 ear tip sizes (XS/S/M/L) for the perfect fit, even in smaller ears.

GREAT FOR SLEEP, FOCUS AND MORE – Quiet 2 earplugs offer instant noise reduction and protection for all kinds of situations, including sleep, focus, relaxation, travel, commuting, general noise sensitivity and more. Loop earplugs are easy to clean and built to last.

EASY TO USE – Quiet 2 earplugs are easy to insert and come with adjustable ear tip sizes for optimal noise reduction and a comfortable fit throughout the day. Just pop them in, twist to secure and enjoy life at your volume. When inserted correctly, Quiet 2 earplugs shouldn't stick out.
IN THE BOX – 1 set of Loop Quiet 2 earplugs, 4 sets of Quiet 2 ear tips (sizes XS, S, M, L – M comes pre-installed), 1 portable convenient Carry Case.

Loop Quiet 2 earplugs strike a good balance between comfort and noise reduction, especially for sleep and everyday noise. They’re not “soundproof,” but for many people they are very effective. The biggest challenges are finding the right tip size for a good seal, and managing pressure if you sleep on your side.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Game-changer for sleeping in my noisy apartment!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I live in an apartment with thin walls and constant background noise traffic, neighbors talking, doors slamming, you name it. I used to wake up multiple times a night or struggle to fall asleep. These Loop Quiet earplugs have genuinely helped me sleep better.They’re super comfortable thanks to the soft silicone and different tip sizes. I can wear them all night, even as a side sleeper, without any pressure or irritation (unlike cheap foam plugs that expand weirdly or fall out). The little loop makes them easy to insert and remove.They reduce noise by about 24 dB (SNR), which mutes the everyday racket enough to create a calm “quiet bubble” without blocking everything completely. I still hear my alarm in the morning, but the distracting sounds are softened so much that I fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer. My sleep quality has noticeably improved since I started using them.They come with a handy carry case, look sleek (not like obvious earplugs), and are reusable easy to clean and way more sustainable than disposables.If you’re dealing with apartment noise and want comfortable, effective earplugs for sleep (or focus), these are worth every penny. Highly recommend!
Great product. Works as described.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: An Aid in Exams for ADHD'ers
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: For any student with ADHD, exams can be tough. With different 'supports' though, one can help create greater focus and attention. Therapy, prescription medications, and behavioural treatment are generally the most effective strategies for doing so, however, personal preferences and circumstances may influence their efficacy. Even with these main supports, I still struggled to maintain my focus when experiencing distractions. External noise was the main distraction to my focus, and I found myself unfairly frustrated by audible inputs; the scratch of pen on paper, or the dim noise of cars driving past the exam hall.After talking to a learning support professional, they recommended these earplugs for exams/formal assessments. Initially, I was reluctant, picturing the cheap orange foam earplugs that never seemed to fit in my ears. But after looking them up online, and seeing the colour options and its silicone material, I decided to give them a try.Throughout two exam periods, this is what I've liked and disliked about the Loop Quiet 2s:The noise reduction manages to block out most of those quiet noises I once found so distracting. However, it is subtle enough that I can hear the invigilator's reminders of time or instructions. So, though it is not effective enough to block out audible inputs to a great extent, it is perfect for my exam settings. I would not use them for studying in a louder area (e.g. cafe or classroom) but for the library it is great. The quality of the item is relatively good, considering the price. The silicone material is comfortable to wear and the size options provided work for me.Disclaimer:Do not buy as a 'cure all' fix that Loop seems to advertise. But, as a support for those who need it, it works well enough. It also may not be approved by your examiners so make sure to check if buying for this reason.
These are amazing,Never been able to sleep in earplugs until now, they are so comfortable you forget you’re wearing them,Block sound amazingly, will get a back up pair.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: So convenient, and they hold up well
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I've had these little things for a couple months now, and I keep one in my purse for lotion while the rest are in my travel bag with various products in them.  I've also started using them in my home shower when I'm trialing new products, as they're a convenient way to hold just enough for one shower.  They're rigid enough not to lose their shape in a bag but plenty malleable enough to squeeze easily for getting the right amount of product out.  I can get about half the bottle into my hand without any trouble from one good squeeze -  not that I usually need that much at once - but they immediately return to their original shape.  I've noticed no damage at all to them from repeat squeezing.  The cap lids click into place solidly without being obnoxious to open, and the refill openings are just right to fit the end of a pump inside for refill.  I've had no problems with leaking, either!  Honestly, these things are perfect.

features: 【Real-Time Temperature Monitoring】With its celsius temperature display, YOUSHARES insulin cooler travel case allows you to effortlessly monitor the temperature inside, give you a piece of mind, enjoy a worry-free travel.

【Compact Yet Spacious Design】Measuring at 21.5 x 9 x 5.8 cm and weighing just 270g, our refrigerated medicine travel case strikes the perfect balance between portability and storage capacity. This travel medicine cooler bag easily fits into your backpack or luggage, making it ideal for use during flights and for traveling.

【Keep Medicine Cool While Traveling】Crafted from PU, EVA, and aluminum foil materials, our insulated medicine travel case offers excellent insulation to maintain the low temperature of your insulin supplies while provides rugged protection against damage to insulin medications from external impacts.

【TSA-Approved Ice Packs for Long-Lasting Cooling】Equipped with two TSA-approved ice packs, insulin travel case TSA approved ensures your medication remains at the optimal temperature for 6-8 hours, making it perfect for fly travel, cycling, rode trip or daily life use. Simply freeze the ice packs for 8-12 hours before use.

【Package Include】1 x insulin pen travel case, 2 x reusable ice packs. YOUSHARES is dedicated to enhancing the convenience and happiness of individuals living with diabetes, empowering them to enjoy worry-free travels and daily activities.

bookDescription:
Make your vacation memories last a lifetime with this awesome fill-in children’s travel journal that’s packed with brilliant activities and prompts to inspire kids to write and draw their adventures. Budding diarists can record precious moments from their trip in this pocket-sized book and create the ultimate holiday souvenir to cherish forever.
Draw your own passport picture; make a cool flip-book animation of your experiences; describe the tastiest treat from your journey - this epic kids’ journal encourages readers to really engage with their travels and create a treasured keepsake that they can look back on years later with the whole family.
Inside Create Your Own Travel Journal:
- Fun fill-in activities including games, drawing challenges and prompts for stories to encourage children to observe and admire their surroundings
- Handy pocket-sized hardback book with an elastic band so readers can take their precious jottings and doodles with them wherever they go
- A super memento to remind kids - and grown ups - of the adventures they share together
- Includes: create a postcard of your favourite vacation destination; make a playlist of the songs you’ve heard during your holiday; make a city skyline using your ticket stubs; draw the view from your room; write about your favourite experience so far; create a special souvenir of your trip; draw all the people you’ve met during your getaway - and more
Create Your Own Travel Journal is the latest book in Lonely Planet Kids’ ‘Create Your Own’ series following on from Create Your Own Holiday Games and Create Your Own Camping Activities. This fun-packed fill-in journal provides the perfect space for creative kids to keep their travel thoughts and musings, so that they can enjoy and remember their vacation for many years to come.
About Lonely Planet Kids: Lonely Planet Kids - an imprint of the world's leading travel authority Lonely Planet - published its first book in 2011. Over the past 45 years, Lonely Planet has grown a dedicated global community of travellers, many of whom are now sharing a passion for exploration with their children. Lonely Planet Kids educates and encourages young readers at home and in school to learn about the world with engaging books on culture, sociology, geography, nature, history, space and more. We want to inspire the next generation of global citizens and help kids and their parents to approach life in a way that makes every day an adventure. Come explore!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: As someone who travels frequently, I've been through my fair share of travel toiletry kits. Most are a frustrating compromise – they leak, they're impossible to fill, or you never have the right type of container. This INSFIT 17 Pack Travel Bottle Set is, without a doubt, the best and most comprehensive solution I have ever used. It has completely streamlined my packing process.The Verdict Up Front:This isn't just a set of bottles; it's a brilliantly thought-out system for anyone who needs to pack liquids. It's perfect for frequent flyers, occasional holidaymakers, and even for a well-organised gym bag. For the price, the quality and variety are exceptional.What Makes It So Good?The Variety is Unbeatable: This is the main selling point. You get everything you could possibly need. The soft, squeezable silicone bottles are perfect for shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. The spray bottles are ideal for facial toner or aftersun, and the little pots are perfect for face creams, lip balm, or even pills. You're never left wishing you had a different type of container.Genuinely Leak-Proof: This is the most crucial test, and the INSFIT set passes with flying colours. The silicone bottles have a multi-layer leak-proof design on the cap that really works. I’ve taken them on multiple flights with no spills or disasters in my wash bag. The peace of mind is invaluable.Effortless to Fill and Clean: The wide-mouth opening on the silicone bottles makes decanting your toiletries incredibly simple – no more balancing a big shampoo bottle over a tiny hole. The set even includes mini funnels for the spray bottles and a small spatula for creams. Best of all, it comes with a cleaning brush, making them easy to rinse out and reuse.Ready for UK Airport Security: The set comes in a sturdy, transparent zip-up bag that is CAA Approved. This means you can just pull it out of your hand luggage and pop it in the security tray without any fuss or last-minute repacking into a flimsy plastic bag.Helpful Labels Included: The pre-printed, switchable labels are a fantastic touch. No more trying to guess which bottle is the shampoo and which is the conditioner. It's a small detail that makes a huge difference when you're in a hotel shower.Any Downsides?Honestly, there are very few. If you're an extreme minimalist, the 17-piece set might seem like overkill, but it’s better to have the option and not need it. The small pots are quite tiny, so they are best for short trips or very concentrated products.Final ThoughtsThis INSFIT travel set has solved one of the persistent annoyances of travel. It’s a well-made, versatile, and complete kit that takes the stress out of packing toiletries. If you're looking for a reliable, leak-proof, and user-friendly travel bottle solution, look no further. Highly recommended.

features: 【Secure Your Bags & Free Your Hands】Effortlessly attach your backpack, purse, or travel essentials to your suitcase with our luggage straps. This innovative travel solution is designed to securely fasten your extra bags, freeing up your hands for tickets, phones, or navigating busy airports and train stations. No more struggling to carry multiple items at once.

【Adjustable Design】Our suitcase strap features a fully adjustable buckle, allowing the length to be customized from approximately 28cm (11") to 48cm (19"). This flexible design ensures a tight and secure fit for a wide range of bag sizes, from small carry-ons to larger travel backpacks, preventing them from slipping or tilting during transit.

【Good Material】Constructed from high-strength webbing and a highly elastic bungee cord, these luggage straps for suitcases are both durable and flexible. The robust materials can withstand repeated stretching and pulling, ensuring your attached bags stay securely in place trip after trip. They are a reliable and long-lasting travel accessory.

【Convenient 2 Pack】This value pack includes 2 durable luggage straps, providing you with a complete solution for your journeys. Use one to secure your primary bag, or use both for maximum stability when attaching bulkier items. Having a spare is always wise, making this 2-pack the perfect preparation for any travel scenario.

【Compact for Easy Storage】Using these straps is incredibly straightforward—just loop the elastic belt around your suitcase handle and the bag you wish to attach, then tighten the buckle. When not in use, the lightweight and compact luggage straps can be easily rolled up and stored in any pocket or corner of your luggage, always ready for your next adventure.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Perfect for no luggage strap bags
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Can’t wait to use these, especially when you have a bag for travelling and no luggage strap on it, this will be perfect and make my life easier.
Love the colours.

It's a useful item but the max length is a bit short, making it not ideal for large, bulky bags. It does work though, and is very handy in attaching bags with no bag sleeve/pocket to your luggage. It's perfect for handbags, medium bags and the like. The image I took is the max length.It's also a bit expensive for what is essentially a stretch of fabric and elastic, but you do get two of them and they do seem well made and sturdy. I got rainbow because of visibility but also I already had some rainbow straps for my luggage and I wanted to match.Overall a handy item to have when traveling-- I got it because when waiting for trains or transport, I would be waiting with my luggage and would usually buy some snacks, drinks etc for the trip-- and have no way to attach the bag of snacks to my luggage. This way I can get this strap out of the side pocket and strap up the snack bag.Also, it's ideal for attaching a bulky plushie to luggage (we won one in the ufo machine and it didn't fit in our suitcase so we had to drape it over the luggage through the bag handle and it kept falling off). It would also be good to attach a pillow if you're the kind of person that needs one on your trip.So for uses like that it's so handy to have with you just in case you need something like this when travelling, though it is a bit niche, I think it's a handy bit of travel gear.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Flying will never be the same!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Absolutely unbelievable! This thing is by far my best ever purchase for travel. It is easy to attach to the headrest flap things and the eye cover attaches easily & securely with strong velcro. It keeps your head from bobbing around. I slept so well. Better than I ever have on a plane. 5 hours sleep straight! For me, that is amazing. It's so comfortable.I'll be recommending this to everyone! I will never fly without it.
Used this on my recent flights and loved it! I slept for hours and no sore neck. Very comfortable and easy to set up and small enough to pack in your carry on.
Excellent product. Only slight negative was effort to constantly remove eye mask when required

The greatest travel pillow I've ever used! I don't think I'll ever need to use a different travel pillow again. This was life changing for a recent 16+ hour flight where I was on an aisle seat, it allowed me stay upright in my seat.The velcro that attaches the eye mask to the headrest is really strong.You can adjust how tight to attach the eye mask which gives a bit of lee-way if sitting straight up is not comfortable.Eye mask is padded and blocks out all light.Took 10 seconds max to attach/remove from the headrest.Only feedback I have is:- I have to check before a flight whether the seat headrest will be compatible (nothing a quick youtube search can't fix)- I wish it came with a silk eye mask option so it's kinder to my skin (I woke up with lines around my eyes from the eye mask paddingBut overall, I'm very happy with my purchase, the item is very well made and recommend this travel pillow to everyone

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Best travel pillow I’ve ever used!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Used this on two back to back long haul flights and it was a life saver! Especially when I got stuck in a middle seat. It’s lightweight, soft and has good cushioning. Takes a bit of practice to get the right angle but when you do…it’s a game changer! I slept solidly for several hours at a time and it completely prevented my head from falling forward. I love that it doesn’t get in the way too. Just clip it on at the start of the flight then stick the eye mask on when you’re ready to sleep. It’s got really strong velcro so it won’t budge but you can still move around. I’ll never use those other annoying neck pillows again!
Used this on an 8-hour flight and slept for most of it, and no crick in the neck.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Product couldn’t be used on on 3 different flights
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I recently arrived home from 3 international flights on 3 different airlines and not once was I able to use this product. All 3 airlines had headrests different than what makes this product useable. Such a shame because I am taller and would have loved this product if it did as described. My neck is always sore when trying to sleep on flights. For context, the airlines were Jetstar, Scoot and AirAsia.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Miracle must-have gadget for long flights!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Ok - I got this on a whim, thinking I probably wouldn’t use it, as it really looks funny. Boy, was I wrong. This thing was a lifesaver for me on a delayed flight home late at night. I started to fall asleep with my head bobbing all over when I remembered this handy gadget. I strapped it onto the airline seat easily, Velcro-strapped the eye mask to it, and I slept so comfortably upright it shocked me. No cramped neck, no head bobbing, and the eye mask was very comfortable, soft and blocked out the light really well. I had no idea the lights turned on before we were going to land, it blocked the light very well. It also helps block out some noise, as it goes over your ears, too… I had my AirPods in, and it was perfectly comfortable,Did it look funny strapping my head to a seat? Maybe. But did anyone - including me -  care? Not a bit. I bet many people wished they had one of these, actually, as I soundly slept for the first time on a flight EVER.I will DEFINITELY use this on overnight long international flights, as well… no more silly neck pillows for me! I’m completely sold on this handy gadget - highly recommend!

bookDescription:
Never forget an adventure with this bright and bold journal from Lonely Planet Kids. Packed with writing topic suggestions, lists to complete, ideas for getting the creative juices flowing and lots more fill-in fun, this is the perfect way for young travellers to record their memories from a trip.

Part of our Family Activity range.
Also available: My Family Travel Map, Boredom Buster
About Lonely Planet Kids: From the world's leading travel publisher comes Lonely Planet Kids, a children's imprint that brings the world to life for young explorers everywhere. With a range of beautiful books for children aged 5-12, we're kickstarting the travel bug and showing kids just how amazing our planet can be.
From bright and bold sticker activity books, to beautiful gift titles bursting at the seams with amazing facts, we aim to inspire and delight curious kids, showing them the rich diversity of people, places and cultures that surrounds us. We pledge to share our enthusiasm and love of the world, our sense of humour and continual fascination for what it is that makes the world we live in the diverse and magnificent place it is.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Pitched perfectly for my 6 and 8 yr old, with a great mix of creative activities
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought 2 of these ahead of a family road trip to the USA. My girls are 8 and 6 and the language, ideas, and activities are pitched just right for their reading ages.Each activity is thought provoking but simple, and encourages kids to think and document some of their obvious and not so obvious holiday experiences. The book is set out along the journey, from anticipation, preparation, then experiences whilst away, and finally summarising. Some of my personal highlights are:  weather watch charts, flag drawing, quotes and catchphrases, and new experiences.For a small book it covers a lot of ground and I can’t wait for my 2 to get stuck in. I like the laid back but informative feel of lonely planet books, and it really shows through with this.Update...  so after recovering from the trip, I was pleased with the journal.  I think (as always) I underestimated how much parental motivation would be needed to help remember, divert from fighting, and move away from screens, but after prompting my 6&8 YO girls both enjoyed the variety of content.  Most of the time my wife and I had to prompt memories but I liked this.  After a few days it became a little of our routine and was a good way to keep them busy whilst we sampled the local giggle juice.Will report back on how it went!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Colorful Convenience with a Squeeze of Caution 🌈✈️
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: As a frequent flyer, I was thrilled to try these travel bottles. The vibrant colors brightened up my toiletry bag and made identifying products a breeze! 🎨 The included labels are a nice touch, though I found myself relying more on the colors for quick identification.The 100ml size is perfect for TSA compliance, giving me peace of mind at security checkpoints. The clear zipper toiletry bag is a fantastic addition, making organization a cinch and speeding up those dreaded security lines.I love the soft silicone material - it's much easier to squeeze out every last drop compared to rigid plastic bottles. The wide openings make filling and cleaning a breeze, no tiny funnels required! 🧼However, it's not all smooth sailing. While the no-drip valve is a great idea, I've had mixed results with leakage. Most of the time, they're perfectly secure, but I've had a couple of surprises in my bag. 💦 I'd recommend double-bagging liquids just to be safe.The 100ml capacity is great for shorter trips, but for longer journeys, you might find yourself needing refills. Not a deal-breaker, but something to consider.One unexpected bonus: these bottles are surprisingly versatile. I've used them for everything from shampoo to sunscreen, and even salad dressing for a picnic! 🥗Overall, these travel bottles offer great value and convenience. They're not perfect, but they've definitely made packing toiletries easier and more colorful. Just remember to give them a little squeeze before packing to ensure they're properly sealed!If you're looking for a fun, TSA-friendly way to carry your toiletries, these bottles are worth a try. Just pack a spare ziplock bag, just in case! 🧳🛫

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Very pleased with these. I’ve never been very successful with vacuum/roll-up organisers as l always manage to end up with a lumpy rigid block, which is good for excluding air for storage but less good for easy regular access or for packing.These cubes have a cunning zipping process that’s quite satisfying but they do not compact items as much as vacuum storage bags  and, at a guess, if over-filled, could put pressure on the zips. However the zips have stood up very well so far and the bags are robust.They do a very good job creating more room in bags, suitcases and wardrobes.The cubes are very light and as far as I’m aware, rinseable. They can also be packed flat inside each other when not in use as opposed to the slightly bulky plastic vacuum bags. It’s not really fair to compare though as these are less for longer term airtight storage and more for easy access and regular use situations. Anyway, they’re functional, neat and are good for the price, I like them!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This little iron worked way better than I thought it would. I bought it for a recent trip to Europe - my clothes were all rolled into packing cubes and I knew they would be wrinkled and crushed when I wanted to wear them. I chose this iron instead of a portable steamer because I hoped it would do a better job of getting creases out of shirts and dresses and I'm glad I did. It ironed my linen dress and linen shirt so well, my husband used it to iron his shirts before going out to dinner. I mostly used the second 'gear', the green setting because even on the lowest steam setting it really packed a punch, ironing was quick and easy. It's light to hold, easy to understand how to use it, and compact enough to make fitting into a medium-sized suitcase no problem. It really was money well spent. I would recommend also buying a travel ironing pad because you'll need to protect the surface you're ironing on from steam and heat. I mostly ironed on the floor because it was easier when using a European adaptor and most places don't offer ironing boards. I would also recommend only placing it down on the plastic stand when it's in dry mode (no steam, first 'gear' or the red setting). When I put it down once on green mode the hot steam started to bend the plastic. In summary, perfect for travelling.

I was pretty sceptical about a steamer especially at this price point but it works really well (for the cost). I wouldn’t say the steam alone on clothes on the hanger does much except for really light crinkles but it produces loads of steam so using it more like an iron is great. I was on a cruise recently and I was able to iron dressed shirts and linen pants easily this way by just laying the item on the bed then quickly running over it like an iron in high steam mode.The weight is as advertised but just be aware that is still quite heavy. But it does feel very sturdy so I wasn’t worried about it getting damaged in transit. It’s also very compact.
Great for travelling, small & compact

This iron has a bit of weight to it, but it works incredibly well. Having the two different functions is a huge plus, making it the perfect companion for traveling. Very happy with this purchase, thank you!
Cute as a button and elegantly fabulous! Love it! And it works like a dream. Takes up no room in my luggage and is a lifesaver.

This little steamer is fantastic. I purchased one for traveling and now I have purchased one for my caravan and one to use at home in place of my original clothes steamer. It is light and does a great job. My daughter tried it so she has now also purchased for her home and caravan. So easy to use.

It was making the shirt somewhat damp, while the wrinkles of the shirt are still not as straight as I expected.The amount of water 120 ml loses water very quickly when used with the steam function blue light.I do not think it is suitable for travel and my expectations.

    ​This vacuum bag set includes various sized bags, a pack of double-zipper sealing clips, a portable electric pump, a USB-A to USB-C charging cable, and a manual 📋.​Everything is ready to use right out of the box.You just pack your clothes into the bags and use the electric pump over the valve to suck the air out.I noticed that the pump’s nozzle is made of hard plastic rather than rubber, which made me a bit skeptical about the seal at first, but it still managed to create a solid vacuum effect 😅.​The set comes with multiple bag sizes, which is great for different needs. I initially thought I could just seal the zippers by hand, but the included sealing clips actually make a huge difference in ensuring a tight, efficient seal 🤓.It’s a bit of a bummer that I received a white pump instead of the black one shown in the promo photos🥲, but it doesn't affect the performance at all💪.This is a great helper for shrinking down luggage and keeping clothes free from dust and mites during storage 🥸.​I’d strongly recommend this for anyone looking to maximize their suitcase space 👍.

Really handy.The Large size fit 2 full size bed pillows in it and you can see the before and after photos - they shrink down quiet a lot.The seal at the front is very secure, a bit hard to open the bags to start with, plus they give you those clips to run along it to make sure it's properly sealed which is very helpful.The little pump is great, I recommend some hearing protection while using it as it's not super loud but it's just that bit of high-pitched and loud enough that is annoying and not good for your ears. But for a small pump it sure manages to push a lot of air out. Don't stop it the minute it seems like it's not shrinking anymore, it does a lot quickly and then a bit more slowly and less obviously.Charge holds to do a fair few bags and in storage for days and then using again, easy to charge and easy to see when it needs more charging.And the way the seal is where the pump goes, plus the top you put over it is a screw on (make sure it's aligned right) seems to hold the vacuum seal well

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The hard copy version is a good book. However, the Kindle version is the worst conversion that I have ever seen (and I have over 1,400 Kindle books). The hard copy appears to have been converted as fixed 2 page images so the text can not be resized nad the images can not be resized. This means that the type on a mobile is too small to read (you get the 2 large pages shunk to fit your mobile screen). Even on a large tablet the text is fixed at about 8 point type which is too small to read comfortably.Also, bookmarking and text highlighting does not work.Finally, the file size is about 270 Mb which is HUGE for such a small book.Overall, it is a truly woeful conversion to Kindle format, which is a pity as the hard copy book is quite good.DO NOT BUY THE KINDLE VERSION

Ich benutze den Andriod Kindle Reader auf meinem Samsung A52 Smartphone. Dort gibt es auch keine Zoomfunktion, mit der ich in Den Text hineinzoomen könnte. Infolgedessen nicht lesbar. Zum Vergleich: das Lonely Planet Buch "Southern Africa" ist exzellent für den Reader aufbereitet. Hierfür gibt's eigentlich fünf Minus-Sterne. Und das Buch geht wieder zurück!

My only worry is how my shearling-lined coats and shirts will come out of their compressed state next autumn :) It's easy to see how they'd be useful for airline travellers although I always had issues with weight rather than bulk.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Effective storage bags with a good range of sizes
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Very effective storage bags with useful size varietyI bought this vacuum compression bag set mainly to store seasonal clothing and spare bedding, and it has worked exactly as expected.The pack includes a good mix of sizes, which I found really useful. I was able to fit bulky items like doonas and pillows into the larger bags, while the smaller ones were ideal for jumpers and everyday clothes. Once sealed and vacuumed, the bags compress down significantly and free up a surprising amount of storage space.The plastic feels thick and durable, not flimsy like some cheaper alternatives I’ve tried in the past. The double zip seal closes securely and I didn’t have any issues with air leaking back in over time. Items stored under the bed stayed fully compressed even after a few weeks.The included hand pump works well and is handy if you don’t want to use a vacuum cleaner, although for the largest bags I found using a vacuum was quicker and easier. Either option seals properly once the air is removed.Overall, these bags do what they’re designed to do and feel well made. They’re especially useful if you’re short on storage space or want to keep clothes and bedding protected when not in use. I’d happily buy these again.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Soft, comfortable and amazing at blocking light!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a fantastic eye mask!!! For the price, it works so so well, not a single gap and no light is able to seep through at all. Amazing, highly recommend!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: BEST mask I have ever tried. Total Blackout!!!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Oh my gosh, I have tried quite a few sleeping masks over recent years and there have been a couple of brands I have been fond of in the past... but WOW... this 2 pack of BeeVines Masks are the best I have ever tried, and such amazing value for money.Total blackness the moment I put them on, even in the middle of the day.I am usually quite a restless sleeper and even though I often change position throughout the night, I found that the mask barely moved. The padding around the eyes is very thick, meaning my eyelashes never touch the mask, and the padding is so soft and comfortable against my face. The adjustable band is a huge bonus too, since most masks i have used in the past have been velcro bands which have really stretched and loosened over time. With the adjustable band you can have it as tight or loose as you like. I would absolutely recommend these masks... so much so, that I am about to order another pack or two to have as spares 🙂

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Improved sleep quality and reduced eye bags!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Frustrated with my silk eye mask that wouldn't stay on during the night, I saw the BeeVines eye mask on Amazon and added to my Prime Day sales haul. I have to say, I absolutely love these eye masks! Super soft, silky fabric that sits nicely around the eye socket. The contoured inner sponge is gentle and comfortable to wear all night. The fact it's adjustable means a perfect fit that hugs my eye area and blocks out light completely. An unexpected benefit for me is reduced eye bags, yes you read right! Because I wear it just slightly tight, i guess it prevents fluid build up? I don't know, but I love them. The pink mask now has a black interior, which provides better darkness. Amazing value for money considering you get 2 eye masks in a cute gift box. They're coming on holiday with me, will be using on the plane as well, can't wait!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great buy. Very happy with the product.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Having bought a different product here on Amazon earlier on which turned out to be dismally ineffective. I decided to give this product a go & ended up being quite pleased. Not least because it was better value, but also because it's far more functional & effective.Wearing the mask, there's essentially no light leakage. The padding perfectly manages to contour the shape of the face, creating a perfect seal.In terms of comfort, it's light, not overly bulky & breathes fairly well.If I had one critique, it would be that perhaps the elastic band is where this product could be improved. A thicker band, perhaps even with a padded section would make it far more comfortable. But as it is, it's functional & does a great job of keeping the mask on the face.The fact that you get 2 masks & added ear plugs makes it a winner.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Super comfy and incredible light block-out!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: THESE ARE HEAVENLY!This purchase was prompted by my husband wanting a sleeping mask to block out the light for when he has trouble sleeping (most nights) or migraines (in clusters a couple times a year), and in trying to decide between the range, we couldn’t go past this set of two at a discount (though we’d buy them at full price without a second thought now that we’ve tried them).The pink does have a black backing to the mask, and the raised padding. This was my main concern when buying this set as it seems to all be pink in the picture, but both masks offer incredible light block-out, and are so comfy. You can feel that you’re wearing them, but they’re soft, don’t put pressure on, and are easily adjustable.The two sets earplugs that come with are a nice little bonus, though we’re not likely to use them, personally. At least not for sleep.
it’s a good product. comfortable and works

As a shift worker, I appreciate the full eye coverage and 100% blackout feature. This eye mask's great ergonomic shape is big enough, covers all the light, feels breathable, and its padding is comfortable.The padding could be in the way JUST on the first time wearing it, but afterwards, you won't even feel it. Also, to have full eye coverage, you need to tighten the elastic strap up. Otherwise, there will be a light leak in the nose area.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I want to shout it from the rooftops – this sleep mask is amazing! I usually don’t write reviews, but you need to know about these masks!1. This is a true blackout mask. If you wear it properly, not a single ray of light gets through. The fabric blocks light completely. It’s made a huge difference in the quality of my sleep.2. I have a larger head and always struggle to find a mask that fits – most of them press on my eyes and feel uncomfortable. This one has an adjustable strap, which is such a game-changer! Even if the elastic stretches over time, you can just tighten it.3. I really love the design – I can actually open my eyes inside the mask. It’s not only comfortable in general, but also a big plus for girls with lash extensions!4. The fabric feels amazing on the skin – super soft and gentle. It’s incredibly comfy.Just a heads-up: it does take a little time to get used to it. Because of the structured design, it might feel awkward at first when sleeping on your side – like it’s getting in the way or slipping off. And if it moves even slightly, light can sneak in through the gaps and it’s no longer blackout. It took me about a week to fully adjust.Now, I can sleep in any position, and I barely feel the mask at all. It stays in the right place on my face until morning. You just need to give it a bit of time – either for you to adapt to it, or for it to adapt to you 😊I’ve been using it for two months now, and my sleep has drastically improved. I’m so happy with this purchase – it’s honestly the best sleep mask I’ve ever had. It’s thoughtfully and intelligently designed, with real care.The quality-to-price ratio is incredible – this mask should cost more! Especially since you get two in the package (my husband wears the second one and he’s loving it too).

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: For years, travel pillows were something I’d grab cheaply before a flight, knowing full well they would flatten halfway through the journey. The usual soft, overstuffed cushions looked comfortable but offered very little actual neck support. After a few hours, my head would tilt forward or sideways, and I’d wake up with stiffness rather than rest. This neck support pillow feels like a proper step up from that cycle of buying and replacing.The structure is the biggest difference. Instead of collapsing under weight, it maintains its shape and supports the neck evenly from all sides. The firmness feels intentional, keeping the head upright without pushing it forward awkwardly. The adjustable strap helps secure it in place, so it doesn’t shift every time you move. That stability makes it far easier to relax, especially during longer flights or car rides where proper posture matters.

This neck pillow is superior to most neck collars in many ways.The collar has good structural support to hold your head up when sleeping, much better than the memory foam collars that tend to collapse when the head drops onto it. The contact points for the face are tapered with a cut for your ears and raised area to support the jawline. It is great if you have actual neck arthritis or disc problems, it keeps your head more upright if you fall asleep and limits the amount of compression on the nerves.The circumference of the pillow is completely adjustable with cords and a clip mechanism to hold the collar around the front.The back of the collar has an adjustable straps that you can fasten to the head rest of a seat. Unfortunately, the strap is not removable and being stuck permanently to the neck collar, it can get in the way.The eye mask is nicely padded with a rim around the eye so there is no direct pressure on the eyes themselves, ours came with a dent in the foam that has not recovered. It doesn’t affect the function, just the aesthetics. The mask is Velcro fastened and offers total block out.The entire set comes in a felt travel bag which would have been better if it came with a carabiner or clip to attach to a carry on bag for aeroplane travel.

I really liked this travel pillow. It’s soft but still gives great support to the neck, which makes a big difference on long trips.I used it on a flight of over 13 hours and it worked really well. It was comfortable the whole time and helped me rest better than expected. Definitely exceeded my expectations.

This neck pillow and 3D eye mask set is very comfortable and thoughtfully designed. The neck pillow provides soft yet supportive cushioning, helping to relieve tension during travel or while resting. It conforms well to the neck and shoulders, making long journeys much more comfortable.The 3D eye mask is lightweight and fits securely without pressing on the eyes. The contoured design blocks out light effectively while allowing space for the eyes to move freely, making it ideal for relaxation or sleep. Both pieces feel soft against the skin and are gentle for extended use.Overall, this set is a practical and reliable choice for anyone looking to improve comfort while traveling or resting. It combines support, quality, and thoughtful design, making it a useful and relaxing travel accessory.

PROS:- Foam is firm enough to actually hold the head up and stop it from flopping around but the outside still feels soft and cosy.- Wraps all the way around the neck. Feels good as it supports the chin and back of the head preventing travel cramps.- Carry pouch is soft and feels great. Slight struggle to place the pillow back but no real complaints. Have had worse before.- Eye mask is decent. Inner layer is shaped so it does not rub against the eyelids while still blocking out light.- Built in straps that should let you hitch pillow to the seat’s headrest.- Stitching is good and there are no loose threads or signs of poor craftsmanship.- Can unzip the cover for a wash after trips.CONS:- There is a strong synthetic smell when you take it out of the box. Need to leave it out for few days prior to use.- Slightly larger and therefore consumes space if you place in hand carry. Non-issue if you hang on the hand carry or keep around your neck.- Straps are permanently attached and not removable.

This one combines 360° neck support, dual-density foam, and a 3D eye mask so you can actually sleep on planes, trains, and long car trips instead of just dozing uncomfortably.❌ Cons:Bulkier than simple neck cushionsThe strap and integrated eye mask system make it more involved than a basic U‑shape pillow, and it will take up some space in your carry-on.More features than occasional travellers may needIf you only take short trips or rarely sleep in transit, a simpler, cheaper pillow might be enough.✅ Pros:All‑in‑one travel comfort kitCombines a supportive neck pillow, firm strap, and contoured 3D eye mask in one patented design, so you get neck support and full light blocking together.360° ergonomic supportWraps fully around your neck to support your head, chin, and back of the neck, helping prevent “bobblehead” and stiff necks on flights and road trips.Dual‑density foamFirm inner core for real support plus a softer outer layer for comfort, so your neck is held up without sinking or getting pressure on your chin and ears.

This is a great neck pillow for long haul flights. It’s unusual as because it has 2 straps you can use to tie it to the head rest. This also helps keep your head up supported. I like this style of neck pillow as it squashes down well and has quick release button. There’s also a blind fold but I’m not keen on those.

features: 【TSA approved】The tsa approved lock certified by both the Transport Safety Administration (TSA) are widely recognized as reliable and secure options for travelers. These locks come equipped with a special key that TSA officers can use to access your luggage without causing any damage to the lock's integrity.

【Easy to use, strong security】Setting the password for these luggage locks is a straightforward process that can be completed in just three steps. The 3-digit combination provides 1,000 possible codes, making it extremely difficult for anyone to crack the code and gain unauthorized access to your belongings. This eliminates the need to worry about key security and offers peace of mind during travel. PLEASE NOTE: The default code is 0-0-0. There is no other method to open it if you forget the code.Make sure press in the reset button fully when you're setting new code once loosen a wrong code will be remembered. No key in the package!

【High quality】The main body of each traval password lock is crafted from high-strength zinc alloy, and the cable is made from cut-resistant steel. With this flexible construction, these locks are capable of withstanding rough handling and can easily fit through most luggage locks or zip-grips. They can be used for a variety of purposes, including on suitcases, backpacks, gym lockers, chests, gun cases, briefcases, cabinets, toolboxes, golf bags, and laptop bags.

【Multiple uses】The TSA approved locks provide assurance that your luggage will remain secure throughout your journey. TSA agents will open and relock your luggage using the special key after inspection, giving you peace of mind for the entire trip.

【TSA ACCEPTED LUGGAGE LOCKS】 The luggage lock come in a 2 Pack, which can help prevent combinations from being mixed up and make it easy to identify checked luggage. The easy-to-read dials ensure that the numbers are legible, and the combination can be reset with a pen or other tool.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Locks of Love for Our Luggage Adventure in America!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: We took these luggage locks with us on our epic three-week journey across America, and oh boy, did they prove their metal (pun intended)! These aren't just locks; they're like the secret agents of luggage security, guarding our bags from the perils of TSA inspections and curious airport hands.The quality? Top-notch. They held up like champs, even after being tossed around more than a salad in a health nut's kitchen. We went through airports, bus stations, and even a couple of dodgy motels, but these locks stayed as secure as my mother's secret cookie recipe.They're easy to use, which is a blessing when you're sleep-deprived and running late for a flight. Plus, they've got that TSA-friendly vibe, so we didn't have to deal with the drama of broken locks or lost keys.By the end of our trip, these locks had become part of the family, almost like a trusty sidekick in our travel saga. If you're planning a trip, especially one as long as ours, these are your new best travel buddies. Five stars for keeping our luggage safe, for being tough as nails, and for making us feel like international travel pros.

Product Description
VANFN - P.TRAVEL SERIES RFID TRAVEL PASSPORT WALLETS: 
The stylish and safely travel organizer and passport holder for men & ladies! 
Designed to block 13.56 MHz frequencies, which are used for credit cards and passports. The high-quality travel organizer opens like a book, providing quick access to neatly stored items inside. 
The zippered organizer provides useful interior pockets to help keep important documents in order and easy to find. On one side, there are several dedicated slots that store credit cards, business cards, membership cards, punch cards, and more. A zippered pocket right below the card-storage slots works well for coins, tokens, and other small loose items. A full-length zippered pocket and large stash pocket offer useful space for storing passports, tickets, and most sizes of paper currency. 
PLEASE NOTICE: 
1. 1-2 cm error of measuring is a reasonable range due to different measurement methods. 
2. It is normal that the color cause a little different due to production batch or ambient light and different display resolution. 
3. Our wallet is designed to block the 13.56 MHz frequency, which is used for credit cards and passports. The signal of some ID badge, access cards and hotel room cards which works in 125 KHz, cannot be blocked by this wallet. 
ABOUT RFID: 
RFID, or Radio-Frequency Identification, commonly involves the use of microchips that contain sensitive financial and personal data that are embedded within passports, credit cards, debit cards, corporate identification cards, student ID cards, and even driver licenses. While carrying any of these items with you, anyone nearby with inexpensive RFID-reading equipment can identify and copy all of the information carried on these microchips. 
Thieves can scan these chips to get your passport photo, ID number, and more information to impersonate your family members, accessing your accounts, and causing havoc for you and your family. 
Our VanFn security travel wallet will insure the safety of this sensitive information. We used RFID blocking technology to protect your valuables and prevent identity information theft.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription:
The media could not be loaded.
                
            
                
            
            
        
    
    








  
  
    The Design----Having four 30ml bottles tucked away in one 17cm cylinder is a clever way to keep toiletries organised. The outer container is about 6cm wide, which fits easily into a standard travel bag. Inside, the bottles are made of a thinner, transparent plastic that flexes when you squeeze it. It’s handy that they have measurements on the side, so you can see exactly how much product you have left before a trip.Using the Pumps----While the folding pump mechanism looks neat, the usability is a bit hit and miss. The area where you actually press down is tiny, only about 1.5cm. I found that if you don't press right at the top of the lever, the pump just flips back down into the closed position instead of dispensing anything. You have to be quite precise with your finger placement to get it to work properly. If the surface area of the pump was wider, it would be much easier to use.The Accessories----They include a set of labels to help you identify what is in each bottle, which is a nice addition. However, the execution is a bit lacking because the font sizes aren't consistent. Some labels have much larger text than others, which looks a bit odd when you’re trying to keep things looking uniform. It’s a small detail, but it makes the set feel a bit less polished.Value for Money----For the price, it’s a decent space-saver compared to carrying four separate bottles. It does the job of keeping everything in one place, even if the construction of the individual bottles feels a bit thin. As long as you don't mind the workaround of having to press the pumps just right, it’s a practical solution for travel. It definitely simplifies a toiletry bag, even with those few design quirks.TLDR - A compact 4-in-1 travel container that saves space by housing four 30ml bottles in one unit. The folding pumps are quite small and tricky to use unless you press them exactly at the top, and the included labels have inconsistent font sizes.

Lonely Planet Japan guidebook is a thick and comprehensive guide, a great companion for travelers seeking to immerse themselves in Japan’s rich culture and diverse landscapes. Whether you're a first-time visitor or a seasoned traveler, it offers to help create memorable experiences. I am using this book to create an itinerary for a trip coming up. the price is better than retail shops.

Make sure you have a good reading light in bed if you plan to digest (as I did) this Lonely Planet (LP) guide before you drift off to sleep. The LP size format is fine but really, the text is almost impossibly small and the pages are semi-translucent meaning the text from the preceding page bleeds into the page you're reading. However, it's all about the information at the end of the day and this volume has it in spades. The major cities, themed areas, onsens, ryokan, trains and the like are all given a fairly thorough treatment. Japan is a compact country with a lot of people and scenery but, running to hundreds of pages, this guide is hardly portable.

We just returned a few hours ago from a three-week trip to Japan--our first. We concentrated on the sites of Honshu (Tokyo, Kyoto, Hakone, Miyajima, Koya-san, Takayama, Kanazawa and more). As a loyal Lonely Planet reader, I was hesitant to purchase this latest edition before our departure, given the negative comments about the new format and its lack of solid information, etc. I'm here to say that this guidebook was GREAT--and was there for us every step of the way on our travels throughout the country. I understand why the people at LP have decided to dispense with opening and closing times and other such detailed info.--because in this day and age, who'd depend 100% on what a guidebook tells you about opening and closing times? I wouldn't--and didn't. With my Japanese Pocket wifi (rented in advance and picked up at the airport upon arrival) and my smartphone, I was always able to plan ahead by consulting a site's website (all available with English language option). LP has taken into consideration a modern-day traveler's needs and curiosity, as well as one's own speedy access to information, and come up with an intelligent, handy, and informative guide. Thank you!

    I have bought several travel books over the past couple of years, but this is by far my favorite. It is so beautifully organized, with sharp, clear pictures. Other travel books I’ve bought either give way too much information about a given place or they give just a few, vague sentences. This book hits the sweet spot. Each location (and therefore are lots!) is summarized in an easy-to-read format (read: you don’t have to hunt through lots of wordy sentences to find out what the draw is for that location), but it still gives the good, basic info you want to know. I love that each location offers an ideal age group (in orange, so you can easily look for ones suitable for your kids) and has a quick one sentence summary in bold of why this is a good location for that month.The flow chart for each month is so creative and fun! My 8yo with ADHD loves to travel, but he’s not one to sit and look through a travel book with me. This, though, I think will hook him and enable us all to dream up our next adventure. Yes, there are way more locations than you could ever dream of going, but that’s the beauty of having so much to choose from. I do agree with other reviewers am that it includes a lot of U.S. destinations (as a US citizen who lives on a budget, this is helpful for me!) but definitely something to consider if you live in the UK.While the idea of the book is about WHEN to travel WHERE, I’m not so much using it that way. It’s just a great way to get loads of suggestions in an easy-to-digest. Truly, this is the BEST travel book (especially for families) that I have seen to date, imo. I am, however, sending for a replacement, as the binding was coming off. I didn’t take off a star because I don’t think that’s fair to the contents of the book, which are amazing.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Da kit da viaggio a routine promossa: la Centella che mi ha convinta
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Ho acquistato questo kit in formato mini in vista di un viaggio in Cile, con l’idea di avere una routine skincare completa ma compatta, senza dover sacrificare nulla nel bagaglio. Quello che non avevo previsto è che sarebbe diventato uno di quei prodotti che, una volta provati, ti fanno dire “ok, questo non resta in formato mini”.Il formato è perfetto per viaggiare: pratico, ben pensato e senza sprechi. Ma la vera sorpresa è stata la qualità dei prodotti, che non hanno nulla di “provvisorio”. In particolare i cleanser sono stati una rivelazione: li ho usati ogni giorno, anche dopo voli lunghi, cambi di clima e giornate intense, e la pelle è rimasta sempre pulita ma mai secca o stressata. Tanto che, una volta tornata a casa, ho acquistato senza esitazioni la versione full size. Per me questo è sempre il test definitivo.La routine è ben bilanciata e coerente, e qui arriva la parte nerd (che per me è un complimento). Il cuore della linea è la Centella Asiatica, ingrediente chiave della cosmetologia coreana per motivi tutt’altro che cosmetici. La centella contiene asiaticoside, madecassoside e acido asiatico, molecole studiate per le loro proprietà antinfiammatorie, lenitive e riparatrici. Agisce rinforzando la barriera cutanea, favorendo i processi di rigenerazione e aiutando la pelle a recuperare più rapidamente dagli stress ambientali. In viaggio questo fa una differenza enorme: aria secca degli aerei, sbalzi di temperatura, sole e cambi d’acqua mettono alla prova la pelle, e avere una routine che lavora davvero sulla barriera è fondamentale.I detergenti, in particolare, utilizzano tensioattivi delicati che puliscono senza alterare il film idrolipidico. Tradotto: niente pelle che tira, niente sensazione di “pulito aggressivo”, ma una base equilibrata su cui i trattamenti successivi possono lavorare meglio. Non è solo skincare comoda da viaggio, è una routine formulata con criterio.In conclusione, è un kit che consiglio sia a chi viaggia spesso sia a chi vuole provare la linea prima di passare ai formati grandi. Nel mio caso è stato un acquisto nato per praticità e finito per diventare un nuovo punto fermo nella routine. Ironia della sorte: l’ho comprato per partire, ma mi ha seguito anche al ritorno.
Produto muito bom, entrega super rápida, tudo certinho.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Love this bag.  Looks really smart and is very versatile.I had another brand of foldable bag that was similar but it had no real structural integrity unlike this one that holds its own shape well.  It does not fold up into a pocket like the other one but still packs down flat if required.  All of the fittings seem robust and the over handle strap with pocket holds it very securely on top of a suitcase (both extended or not).I travel on a small airline (Rex) and so it must have the bottom zipped up to fit as a carry-on bag to be shoved under the seat but being able to extend it once off the plane is great and makes it very versatile.  Has heaps of room when fully extended but is not an unwieldy size.  I do use an easily removable bag divider/insert to contain smaller items which increases the versatility exponentially.On a recent week long trip it easily held my raincoat folded up at the bottom with the insert on top so it was readily accesible when needed. I sometimes had it packed to bulging and the strong zip closed easily and stayed shut.Highly recommend and would buy another one without hesitation if ever needed.

From the ultimate hiking trails to the most scenic train rides, the most stunning coral reefs to the most epic mountain retreats, you'll find 1,000 exceptional destinations to add to your travel bucket list!Discover your next great adventure in this beautifully illustrated guide to the world's best travel destinations. From the ultimate hiking trails to the most scenic train rides, the most stunning coral reefs to the most epic mountain retreats, you'll find 1,000 exceptional destinations to add to your travel bucket list!Each of the 1,000 bucket list-worthy trips in this sumptuous volume has been carefully vetted and selected by the celebrated travel experts at National Geographic. On every page you'll find new ways to experience beloved destinations, such as a family-friendly tour of Rome's beloved ruins or a foodie tour of New York City, as well as hidden gems around the globe, including a cloud forest in the mountains of Ecuador and a kite surfing excursion off the coast of Spain. Plus, find detailed road trips to places near (Charleston, South Carolina) and far (a grand tour of Switzerland), along with top 10 lists from the best ski resorts to the best green hotels. Discover majestic nature escapes, family getaways, cultural hot spots, remarkable cityscapes, and one-of-a-kind thrills in this beautifully illustrated collection that will help you find your next exhilarating destination.So get ready to pack your bags...this inspired collection will leave ready to experience the ultimate travel adventure!

aPlusContent.title: Product Description
aPlusContent.rawText:
Product Description
Your Perfect Travel Companion 
Are you tired of restless, uncomfortable journeys? Say goodbye to neck pain and discomfort with the TRAVELREST Ultimate Travel Pillow, the ultimate accessory for your travels! Whether you're on an airplane, in a car, bus, train, or even just sneaking in a quick nap at the office, this versatile pillow has got you covered. 
Perfect for All Travel Modes 
Whether you're a jet-setter, a road tripper, or a commuter, this pillow is your ideal travel companion. It ensures you're well-rested no matter where you go, making it perfect for planes, cars, buses, trains, and even camping trips. 
Adjustable Inflation for Desired Comfort 
Our product introduces an innovative feature that sets a new standard for comfort: Adjustable Inflation for Desired Comfort. Say goodbye to one-size-fits-all solutions, and welcome the freedom to customize your comfort level with ease. 
Foldable and Easy to Carry 
Our product is designed with your convenience in mind. With its foldable and portable design, it's a game-changer for travelers and adventurers alike. 
Adjustable Strap for Sizing 
Our product comes equipped with an Adjustable Strap for Sizing, ensuring that it's tailored to your unique needs. No more settling for one-size-fits-all solutions – now you can enjoy a comfortable and customized experience like never before. 
Relaxing and Comfortable 
Our product is meticulously designed to provide you with an oasis of relaxation and ultimate comfort. Whether you're seeking solace during travel or simply unwinding at home, we've got you covered. 

Elevating Travel Comfort and Convenience 
HiGear Design, based in California, proudly presents Travelrest. Our dedication lies in crafting innovative products to enhance comfort in both life and travel. Established by seasoned travelers, our array of accessories, from travel pillows to blankets and adjustable sleep masks, is tailored to ensure pleasurable and serene journeys. 
TRAVELREST Ultimate Travel Pillow & Neck Pillow 
The secret to its unrivaled comfort lies in its revolutionary "Adjustable Inflation for Desired Softness" feature. With this unique innovation, you have full control over the pillow's firmness level, allowing you to personalize your comfort like never before. Whether you prefer a plush and soft pillow or a firmer support for your neck, the TRAVELREST pillow delivers. 
Provides Full Lateral Support for the upper body making it easier to relax, fall asleep, and stay asleep longer. 
Promotes proper head and neck alignment - Keeps Head From Falling Forward. 
Easily loops over headrests in cars and airline seat wings. 
Position across the torso or down the side. Wear like a messenger bag or tether to an airline seat. 
Optional Cover Sold Separately. 
Compact, Portable, and Customizable 
The TRAVELREST Ultimate Travel Pillow is not only designed for your comfort but also for your convenience. It rolls up small, making it an ideal travel companion. And with adjustable inflation, it's like having a custom pillow in your pocket, ready to provide the support you crave whenever and wherever you need it.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I got this for my girlfriend who had a knee replacement. She loved it as she had to keep her leg elevated when she was sitting.  She was able to declare it and carry it to work  and use it  during her  working day.  It blows up to just the correct height.Comes in a carrier bag and is  quiet compact. It is also height adjustable and came in a pack of two. Very pleased with this product

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Handy to have around as an ottoman
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The item seemed to be of reasonable quality when it was fully inflated for use.  When it first arrived, it was all scrunched up and hard to tell how you were able to partially inflate it to get a smaller size.  Turns out it has two compartments to inflate separately; one compartment is the smaller one, which is one-third the height.  However, it doesn't look that great when you only inflate one compartment, so I ended up just inflating the lot and using it as an ottoman.  The black colour makes it look reasonably stylish, and it's the same height as my coffee table, so it's a great height to rest my foot.  It is comfortable to use and seems to be holding up its shape.The only reason I gave it a four-star rating is that you need an air pump adaptor that allows you to pump up paddle paddleboard so the air doesn't leak out when you stop pumping.  You can mouth blow it up, but there's no back valve mechanism to stop air leak when you try to plug it, so it doesn't really work.  Also, you can't really press the valve back in after inflation so it sticks out and doesn't make the ottoman look good.  Lucky, the valves close tightly and haven't managed to pop out while in use.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great size variety with sturdy, thick PVC panels
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This 4 pack of clear bags is exactly as shown and described, offering a really useful range of sizes for toiletries or makeup, with the smaller bags being the fantastic size for my large crossbody bag. The clear PVC is thick and sturdy, which makes it easy to find what you need quickly. The zips move smoothly and the wide opening is practical for larger items, such as bottles if you are using these bags as a toiletries bag when flying.The only potential issue I could see in the long term is the plastic potentially pulling away from the zipper fabric if they are overstuffed. While the seams feel reinforced for now, they might be the first thing to wear out with heavy daily use. For the variety of sizes you get, they offer good value for staying organized while travelling, or just for everyday use.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great visibility and convenience - durability for longterm use is questionable. Frosted sides!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The set works well enough for quick trips, and I found the different sizes handy when I was trying to keep my toiletries from migrating all over my bag. They’re lightweight and easy to pack, and for the price you do get a practical little lineup. I also liked being able to see everything at a glance, which made airport screening a bit less of a juggle.The cheaper construction shows up once you start handling them more. The zipper feels a bit flimsy and I wouldn’t trust it if you tend to overfill your bags the way I sometimes do. Mine also had a frosty look on the sides that isn’t obvious in the photos, so that’s worth keeping in mind if you prefer a clearer finish. I can see these holding up fine for short-term or occasional use, but I’m not convinced they’ll last long if they’re part of a heavy travel routine.Overall, good value for what you pay and perfectly fine for light use. Just temper expectations around durability.

bookDescription:
Take a photographic journey through every country in the world with this beautiful fourth edition of our global bestseller that makes the perfect coffee table book. Discover a bounty of breathtaking images on every page; find fun little-known facts; and learn more about the lives and landscapes of those we share our fascinating planet with.
Sail on slow boats through the backwaters of the Mekong Delta in Vietnam; seek out Italy's finest pizza in the cobbled lanes of Naples; spy whale sharks in Australia's World Heritage-listed Ningaloo Reef - and that's just for starters. Expert insider knowledge accompanies every country featured in this definitive guide and provides the best time of year to visit as well as must-see and do experiences recommended by Lonely Planet writers. There's even suggestions on the best books to read, music to listen to, and food to eat, so that readers can get further under the skin of the world we live in.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: There's little in this world that i love more than traveling. OK, pizza, yes. Oh, and puppies. But other than that there's little in this world that I love more than traveling. I've been using an oversized Passport Wallet that's given me good service for many years, but this is definitely an upgrade.The old wallet was an inch longer and 1/2" wider and a bit thicker. All of this made it hard to find a convenient place for it as I traveled through customs, inspection lines, etc. as it didn't fit in the standard zipper or water bottle compartments on my travel backpack nor my carryon bag.This unit is smaller but extremely high-quality material. The RFID block is a nice new feature which hopefully I won't actually need, but as the Boy Scouts say I'd rather "have it and not need it than need it and not have it". It holds my passport, vaccine card(s), credit cards, cash, and business cards with ease, zips securely, and most importantly it actually fits into my zippered compartments OR even into my pants pocket!Very happy with this new addition to my travel ensemble!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Flexible & Sturdy Top Quality. Value for Money.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I usually use an Ikea zip bag when I take my mini toiletries onboard my flight, but I always come across the same frustrating issue. Either the bag rips, or the zip part rips. If you're anything like me, you'll probably like to cram as much product in the bag as possible (notorious overpacker obsessed with "what if I need this to?"). So I decided that I needed to get a proper toiletry flight bag for my upcoming 1 month, 4 flights trip. After testing the bag with some mini travel products and other essentials, this is my conclusion on the product's function and quality:✅  The ziplock is very strong, while the bag itself is thick enough with flexibility. I tested it with just some mini skincare, hair oil, and eye drops and still had more room for some make up items if I needed to maybe put a mini cushion foundation and gloss/lip balm, and contact lens case.✅  Though slightly heavier than a typical ziplock bag, for the quality, I'd still consider this lightweight.✅  The strap is a bonus feature and makes it easy to carry when taking it out and holding while walking down the aisle without dropping it or waiting in line for the toilet. Just slip it onto your wrist to avoid dropping the bag.✅  After cramming it with as much stuff as I think the bag allowed, I tested carrying it in different ways, and putting in a bag with other items pressing against it, and the ziplock did not give any signs of opening and the bag did not feel like it was going to rip at all.✅  The bag is easy to clean and wipe down if you drop it or get it wet when using it in the toilet.Besides the quality, the quantity offered in this set makes it a great value for money. I can share it with the rest of my family members, or use the extras for setting up ready made toiletry travel bags in advance. I'd definitely highly recommend this.

This set of 6 clear travel toiletry bags measures 20 x 20 cm each and is TSA approved, making them ideal for carrying liquids through airport security. The gray-trimmed bags are made from durable transparent material, allowing for quick inspection while keeping toiletries organised and secure.The bags are lightweight and easy to pack in a suitcase or carry-on. They are suitable for men and women, accommodating liquids, skincare products, or makeup. The zippered closure ensures items stay in place and prevents spills during travel.Pros:Set of 6 TSA-approved clear bagsDurable and lightweight materialZipper closure keeps contents secureEasy to see contents for airport securitySuitable for liquids, skincare, and makeupCons:Limited size for larger bottlesClear material may show personal itemsFinal thoughts:These clear travel toiletry bags provide a practical and stress-free solution for air travel. The TSA-approved design, combined with durability and convenient size, makes them ideal for organising liquids and other small essentials while on the go.

​I picked these up for a holiday I have coming up, and after testing them out while packing, I’m really happy with the quality for the price. If you’ve ever had a bottle leak in your main suitcase or felt the stress of fumbling with ziplock bags at airport security, these are a massive upgrade.The 20 x 20cm size is the sweet spot. It’s large enough to fit all my essentials travel sized shampoo, toothpaste, sunscreen, and even some larger skincare bottles but it still meets the TSA/airline requirements for liquids. Because they have a bit of a flat profile, they slide easily into the front pocket of a carry-on or the top of a backpack without taking up weirdly shaped space.Unlike the cheap sandwich bags you get at the airport, these feel like they’ll actually last a few trips. The plastic is clear but thick enough that it won't puncture easily. The triple seal  style at the top is the best part it feels very secure. I did a quick test with a little water inside, and it didn't leak, which gives me peace of mind in case a cap pops open mid flight.​I didn’t think I’d care about the little lanyards, but they are actually super handy for hanging the bag on a bathroom hook in a hotel or just carrying it to the shower.They are completely transparent, so you don't have to dig around to find your lip balm or eye drops.Getting three in a pack is great value. I’m using one for liquids, one for my electronic cables and chargers, and keeping the third as a spare (lor for my partner to use.If you have a trip coming up, save yourself the headache and grab these. They look much more organized than disposable bags and feel sturdy enough to survive multiple holidays. Definitely worth the $10!

Rundung 5mm dick.der Löffel 17,4cm lang und wiegt 33 Gramm,vorne max. 3,6cm breit.Vorne bzw. am Mundstück haben alle drei eine Materialstärke 1,5mm und am Griff dann 2mm (ausgenommen des Löffels mit 5mm).Die Zähne vom Messer sind auch gut zu fühlen und schön hartkantig, sollte zum schneiden gut geeignet sein (eine glatte, ein gezahnte Seite).Gabel und Messer sind Top in der Größe genau so gut wie das Zuhause, nur halt 1,5-2cm kürzer im ganzem.Lediglich der Löffel ist mir persönlich etwas klein.Die Kanten sind auch ausreichend abgerundet, nicht so wie bei teurem Heimbesteck aber angeschliffen und haben keine unangenehmen Stellen.Aber es passt auch ein "richtiger" Löffel rein und ein stabiles scharfes Messer rein,hab das mal als mögliche Kombination neben die Box auf den Foto gelegt.Wobei ich zugeben muss das es knapp ist aber die Box schließt trotzdem ohne Druck bzw. ohne abzustehen.(mein Löffel von Zuhause hat aber auch ein Größe, bis zu 4,5cm breit)Klappt bei mir aber auch nur weil die Gabel sich dabei sehr gut an den Löffel anschmiegt, kann es für euer Besteck also nicht garantieren.Die Box ist auch echt in Ordnung, die Verschlusslasche ist an sich fest und kann nicht geknickt werden wie die Laschen an einer Tupperbox,also bitte nur leicht wegdrücken und dabei öffnen dann sollte die Box auch lange halten.Zuletzt noch zur Farbe, ich habe die schwarze genommen. Nicht wegen dem Besteck was aber schon ein kleiner Hingucker ist,sondern weil die weiße Box auf den Produktbildern so durchsichtig erscheint. Also ausgenommen wenn man die schwarze Box mal gegen eine Lampe hält ist Sie absolut Blickdicht,niemand wird's sehen wenn Ihr das schmutzige Buttermesser reingetan habt.
