productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great way to keep suitcase packed tightly and keep clothes organised
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: These packing cubes are the better style, with compression zips. They work even better than standard packing cubes, as you can fill them and then compress the clothing by doing up the zip which runs around the outside of the cubes.The 9pce set contains 5x compression style packing cubes and 4x shoe bags. The shoe bags are a great addition, I was previously just using recycled shopping bags but these are much better and have clear windows so you know which pair is in each bag.The only improvement I would suggest is to remove the labels (I don't always end up putting the pre-assigned clothing type in each labelled bag), and an additional large bag would be appreciated for worn items which require laundering.

These are actually very practical for segregation and compression of clothes / shoes in suitcases or even for storage of clothing in general. The addition of the mesh to quickly see what cube holds what is also a nice touch.Being able to also pull these from the suitcase at the hotel to hang on clothes racks for easy access is also highly practical.The fabric upon inspection is durable, the zips are a good size and freely flow when zipping. Definitely a recommended travel accessory.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: These compression packing cubes are a must have for me when traveling! They help keep me organized and are even great for carry-on’s! I usually have the messiest suitcase and end up having to wash everything because all of my dirty clothes are mixed with the clean ones. This helps keep everything organized and cuts down on my laundry, especially since I always tend to overpack!The zippers are nice and strong and don’t split or catch on the fabric. To use them to “compress” clothing you simply fill the bag, zip up the first zipper, press them down and do up the second one. They save a ton of space and I can fit way more in my suitcases without feeling overwhelmed. The bags are made from ripstop nylon fabric which is very durable and doesn’t hold on to scents. The seaman are well sewn so they can be packed to the max without having to worry about them tearing or splitting open.I wouldn’t hesitate to buy more of these and think they would be a perfect gift for the traveler in your life. Highly recommend!

Great compression bags. So useful in storing various clothes, towels, beddings you may have to hoard. I love how the bags can fit into one another. A bag inside a bag inside a bag. Like a russian doll. Like the guy in titanic in inception. These are the bags that will hold your dreams and life within your house, within your room, within your closet. Get your inception bag today.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Good for travel but not compact
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Good quality for the price. I don’t think the additional zipper to make them more compact does anything though.

This compression bag set consists of 4 different sized bags as well as a shoe bag and a drawstring bag.  The material is made of strong nylon and the zippers are smooth and seem good quality.  They didn't stick or get caught in the material.  The best way to ensure your zippers don't get caught in the material is to go slowly and pull both sides of the material together to make it easier for the zipper to pull through.  This is true for any brand of compression bags.  Because of the strong material I don't think they will come apart at the seams but you would have to use them a bit to find out how long wearing they are.  Just don't try and overpack and do a few trial tests first to see what it can handle.  I did a test packing with the largest bag.  I included 4 long sleeved tops, 3 pairs of jogging pants, 1 pair of jeans, 2 short sleeved tops, 1 3/4 sleeved top and 1 pair of leggings (in photo).  It closed completely, with me being careful and everything fitted nicely.  Just remember to stack things evenly and try not to have more on one end than the other.  I'm happy with the results and I will use them for future trips.  The shoe bag and drawstring bag are a bonus and will come in handy.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Strong and durable compression cubes so you can pack a lot more and stay organized!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I recently used these compression packing cubes for a weekend trip where I did not want to check in the bag and just wanted to put everything into a carry-on. With the help of these packing cubes, I was able to fit everything I needed for 4 days into a small carryon bag. The material is very strong and sturdy and I actually prefer the fact that it doesn't have mesh-like many other compression cubes because I find the mesh is where it often rips first. The various sizes of cubes allowed me to easily organize my clothing and I was able to compress it to fit double the amount I would have normally been able to. I simply put the clothes I wanted into the packing cube and then zipped the second zipper to compress the size to about 1/3 of the original size. I was very happy with these compression packing cubes and will be using them on my future travels as well!

What makes it different than other travel pillows? 
Trtl provides support without the discomfort often experienced with other pillows. The internal support system ensures better head and neck alignment. Additionally, it’s lightweight, compact, and easy to carry. 
How do I wear the Trtl Pillow? 
Undo the fastening, place the internal support to your neck, and wrap like a scarf. Place it between your neck and seat for support. Position it on either side or the front of your neck to achieve support in a way that works for you. 
How easy is it to carry and clean? 
The Trtl Travel Pillow is lightweight and easy to carry, pack, or wrap around. It’s also machine washable, thanks to its super-soft, skin-friendly fabric. Plus, it’s fast-drying, making it easy to keep fresh for your next adventure. 
Does it come in different sizes? 
The patented design fits any neck shape, jaw, and shoulder, ensuring comfortable sleep. 
What makes it scientifically proven? 
The Trtl Pillow's patented design is scientifically proven because it holds the head and neck in an ergonomic position, unlike traditional travel pillows. The structure fits any neck shape, jaw, and shoulder, combining to provide optimal support.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I’ve probably tried out eight different travel pillows over the years, everything from the beanbag type that is shaped like a doughnut to the thing that looks like a scarf to hold your head up, to traditional travel pillows, and everything in between. And this pillow got it right, it took the best from every different type of pillow and put it into one. It looks exactly like the pictures and performs as expected. Why it’s awesome: first is the obvious, it keeps your head from flopping forward and waking you up because The pillow itself attaches to the headrest of the airplane seat. And because the front of the pillow has a cinch string, which makes it possible to close the pillow completely around your neck and cradles your jaw/chin, it actually keeps your head from flapping forward if you make it tight. But the pillow and the fabric are firm but soft so it’s not uncomfortable when the pillow is tight. I think the height of the pillow is perfect regardless of how short or long a neck you have because the pillow is plush and can accommodate. The pillow cradles your head on all four sides it also keeps your head from tilting to the side too much. There is padding on the back of the pillow, but not too much, so it would be comfortable to use even if you didn’t end up attaching it to a headrest (I used it in bed lol). it comes with a great travel bag that compresses it a bit for easy traveling. I like attaching a carabiner to the bag strap so that I can easily attach it to the outside of my suitcase or backpack. I haven’t tried washing the exterior yet, supposedly it comes off, but one reviewer said that did not end well. TBD on that.

description: Discover the perfect companion for your travels with the Lendolk Large Travel Backpack. This stylish and versatile backpack is designed to fit 40L of clothing and travel essentials, making it ideal for short trips or everyday use. The main pocket is spacious enough to hold your travel goods, while the front compartment features various pockets for quick access to small items like notebooks, pens, and earphones. The built-in laptop compartment fits most 15-inch laptops and is situated close to your back for added protection. One of the standout features of this backpack is the USB charging port, which allows you to charge your electronic devices on-the-go by connecting your own power bank. The trolley sleeve on the back makes it easy to attach the backpack to your carry-on luggage for hands-free transport. Additionally, the hidden anti-theft pocket on the back protects your valuable items from thieves. The backpack also features an independent shoe compartment on the bottom to keep your shoes separate and clean, and a wet bag with high-density waterproof material to separate dry items from wet items. The adjustable breathable shoulder straps and air-mesh ventilated back panel ensure comfortable carrying, even when the backpack is fully loaded. Made of durable nylon and polyester material, this backpack is both water-resistant and perfect for hiking and other outdoor activities. The Lendolk Large Travel Backpack is designed for adults and is available in a unisex style. Care instructions include hand washing only. With its large capacity, convenient features, and stylish design, this backpack is a must-have for any traveler or commuter.

I noticed right away that the firm yet soft structure stopped my head from bobbing, and I actually woke up free of tension around my shoulders and upper back.I tossed the pillow into my carry-on side pocket for the return leg, and it practically disappeared next to my laptop charger. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This 4 pack of 60 ml travel bottles is really useful for keeping toiletries organised when travelling. The size works well for flights (less than 100ml), and having multiple bottles means you can pack shampoo, conditioner, body wash, or lotion separately and with enough quantity in them for days.The included labels are useful if your products look the same, and the included storage bag keeps the bottles together neatly in your luggage. The bottles feel reasonably sturdy and the lids stay secure, so there’s no worrying about leaks in your bag. The bottles are easily squeezable too should you wish to squeeze out the last bit of product inside it.Overall, it’s a well made and convenient set that makes packing toiletries simple and stress free.

I got this set of travel bottles to review and they've been handy on a recent trip. It comes with four 60ml bottles which is just the right size for carry-on luggage since they're well under the 100ml limit. Each one holds plenty of product for a decent length trip, so you can fill them up with shampoo, conditioner, body wash and lotion without running out after a couple of days.The build quality is decent for what they are. The plastic feels solid enough that I'm not worried about them cracking in a bag, and the lids close firmly with no sign of leaking. They're flexible enoguh to squeeze out the last of whatever product is inside, which is a small thing but appreciated. The set also comes with a little storage bag which I guess could be useful if you have no toiletries bag, but seems wasteful otherwise.There are also some adhesive labels included, which I thought was a nice touch. When you've got four identical clear bottles full of similar looking liquids, being able to label them saves you from playing guessing games in the shower. Overall a practical little kit that does exactly what it's supposed to without any fuss. Good option if you travel fairly regularly and want to stop buying those tiny overpriced travel bottles.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The packing cubes themselves; in material, design, looks, and function (at a basic level) would be 5 stars.The ability to compress them, reliably & smoothly zip and unzip the openings, and to easily put in and take out clothes forces me to only give this 3 stars.If the openings were larger or could completely unfold (like a leaflet or luggage style bag), if the zippers were upgraded, and the ability to compress the bag more easily was improved - this would be a no-questions-asked 5 star product.From my use, it’s extremely difficult to fit more than 2-3 pants in the large cube and 4-5 t-shirts in the small one. productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: This neck wallet did not disappoint
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I got it to replace my old trusty neck wallet, which had seen its fair share of adventures. With an upcoming trip on the horizon, I was eager to find something that not only offered security but also durability.First off, it's not just a wallet; it's a travel companion that's built to last. The moment I held it, I could feel the quality. The water-resistant rip-stop nylon and those double-stitched seams are like a promise that this wallet will be my partner on many journeys to come. It's tough and rugged, just the way I like it.Now, let's talk about security. In today's digital age, RFID blocking technology is an absolute must. Knowing that my cards, IDs, and other valuables are safe from digital theft is like having a guardian angel with me. It's a comforting feeling, especially when you're exploring new places.But what really won me over is the flexible storage. This wallet is like Mary Poppins' bag – it can hold almost everything! Cash, coins, electronics, passports, tickets, you name it. Plus, that adjustable hook is a game-changer. I can wear it comfortably around my neck, adjusting it to the perfect length for me. It's like a customized fit that's as comfortable as my favorite pair of jeans.The only downside is that it can feel a tad bulky under thin clothing layers, but honestly, it's a small price to pay for the peace of mind it brings. I can't wait to take it on my upcoming trip. It's not just a wallet; it's a part of the adventure now.So, whether you're a seasoned traveler or just someone who values security and convenience, this RFID Neck Wallet is the real deal.

bookDescription: This special 30th anniversary edition of the Touring Atlas of Australia is an essential for any Australian road trip. With sales of over a million copies across editions, the large-scale maps for this latest edition have been revised and updated, incorporating many more touring-related features than ever before. Updates include: Complete road update National Park update Aboriginal Land and Indigenous Protected Areas update Traditional names for capital cities have been added to the Australia map, the strip maps and the state opener maps All of the 1700+ rest areas have been updated and categorised to show the reader where there are toilet facilities and free camping, as well as recommended low-cost camping areas. The maps also show visitor information centres. Whether heading off on a weekend getaway or travelling around this vast country, the Touring Atlas of Australia is a consistent performer and is the best large-format road atlas in the country.

The durable material withstands rigorous travel while remaining lightweight. The breathable mesh panels allow easy content identification and ventilation, while reinforced double-stitched seams and smooth zippers ensure long-lasting performance. Your garments stay fresh and organized throughout any journey.

【Complete Travel Organization System】This comprehensive set includes 3 X size-varied packing cubes, 1 X Bra Underwear Bag, 1 X Toiletry Bag, 1 X Drawstring Laundry Bag, 1 X Shoe Bag, 1 X Zippered Bag - everything needed to separate clean/dirty clothes, underwear, cosmetics, and electronics. The color-coded system saves packing/unpacking time, while compression-friendly design maximizes suitcase space by up to 40%. Perfect for 18-32" suitcases, backpacks, or duffels.

【Engineered for Travel Convenience】Thoughtful features enhance every trip: wide-mouth openings for easy packing, grab handles for quick access, and spacer cloths to isolate soiled items. The tear-resistant honeycomb fabric and elasticized reinforcement strips prevent bulging damage, while ring-shaped zipper pulls enable one-handed operation. Mesh panels keep contents visible yet protected from dust and odors.

【Versatile for All Adventures】Ideal for business trips, family vacations, camping, cruises, or gym sessions. Use the large cube for jackets/jeans (40x30cm), medium for shirts (33x26cm), small for accessories (30x20cm), and specialty bags for shoes/toiletries. When not traveling, the foldable cubes (3cm thick when stored) work as drawer organizers at home. Multiple color options available to match your luggage.

【Customer Satisfaction Guaranteed】We stand behind our products with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If any quality issues arise, contact our support team for immediate resolution. Hand wash recommended to maintain fabric integrity. Invest in stress-free packing - this set makes an excellent gift for frequent travelers and organization enthusiasts alike.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A clever design that did the job well
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought these 90ml travel bottles after doing a bit of research (by reading the reviews here on Amazon) of a variety of products at, and below, their price-point. I provided an initial review of these bottles before I used them and I’m now updating it now after my travels over the new year.I was impressed when I first opened the pack, surprised by the bottles’ quality. The material used (silicon?) is light and flexible but also seems very durable. The design is actually very clever and I suspect a lot of thought has gone into this.The bottles are soft, easy to squeeze and I didn’t find that they slipped in my hand when wet and soapy.Half a turn unscrews the lid to reveal an opening with a 20mm diameter that I found made them easy to fill with shampoo, conditioner and shower gel. The outlet is smaller, about half this diameter, and covered by a fixed flap with a split in it (like some shower gel bottles use) so nothing escapes unless the lid is open and the bottle is squeezed.Importantly, none of the bottles leaked at all during any of the four legs of my international flights.And that wasn’t a surprise actually because , as my pics below show, when you squeeze the bottle (empty or full, it doesn’t matter) then close the lid, the bottle actually holds its shape and does so for quite a while.When I first started using the bottles, I was unscrewing the lid a fraction after use to let the air back in. But then I realised that if I didn’t do that, it was actually easier to get product out of the bottles on my next use. Then once I emptied the bottles at the end of my travels, they went straight back into their original shape, without a hint of having been kept out of shape for long periods.The bottles are so good, I think I might go on holiday again, just so I can keep using them. ;-)
So far so good, will see how we go when I actually travel with them. They seem to be good quality.

Perfect for up to a week long trip or more (?) for various shampoos, conditioners, body lotions and body washes. The quality plastic case keeps everything contained and secure from potential spills or leaks in my larger toiletries bag. A good variety of labels.

Great travelling kit when you don't have to lug around big bottles of shampoo, shower gel, conditioner etc. Glad came with stickers so you know what's in your kit. Top quality and good value for money. Very happy.
I found these to be perfectly suited for my 3 and half week trip to Europe.

I was initially hopeful with the bottles seeming to be good quality, however, 3 out of 5 bottles leaked during a 2.5 hour domestic flight. Thankfully the waterproof pouch they come in saved the rest of our luggage from being ruined by the leakage. Don’t waste your money.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Get yourself a travel neck pillow, even if it's not this one
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’ve flown long-distance many times over the years but never used a travel neck pillow of any sort before. As I’m getting a bit older, it seemed like maybe I should start using one for an impending flight to help be more comfortable and possibly get more sleep. So I bought this inflatable pillow based on Amazon reviews. It arrived on the designated day and the item was exactly as described and pictured.Using a pillow like this for the first time made me realise that I should probably have been using one for years, even when I was much younger. As strange as neck pillows look, they provide support for your neck and I definitely got more sleep using this pillow than I usually do on long haul flights.This particular pillow blows up easily via a large (20mm) inlet. I’m adult male and it took three full breaths to blow it up to what felt like a satisfactory firmness. The inside of the mouthpiece has a flap to prevent the air escaping between breaths which is helpful. That said, releasing the air to deflate the pillow was easy. Remove the plug and gently push your finger into the mouthpiece, this pushes the flap back and the air inside readily escapes.The pillow also came with a little pouch which was useful and the manufacturers also provided an eye mask. The eye mask was good at blocking light from nearby screens when the window shades were all pulled down and the cabin lights dimmed. But it didn’t fully block light when the cabin lights where turned on and/or the window shades were open so you may not want to rely on this mask.As this was my first neck pillow, I can’t really comment on whether the shape was a good one or not but that’s probably a personal thing anyway because everybody is built a little differently. If I was a regular long-haul traveller, I’d definitely experiment with different shapes and sizes to see which one works best for me.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Fantastic bag in every way (except MAYBE the zipper quality - only time will tell).KEY DIFFERENTIATOR - True 2 in 1:Almost every travel backpack is useless as an EDC because, when it is mostly empty and the straps are cinched up, the straps get in the way of everything.Not this bag!The top strap ONLY covers the main compartment zipper (which is hidden, like all carry-on backpacks, when the sides are accordian folded inward and the straps are cinched up).  However, unlike most backpacks, every other pocket is 100% accessible, with only minimal interruption from the straps on the third front pocket.The front pockets are huge, awesome and varied.  The side laptop pocket is a dream to access (although it doesn't have a false bottom, it seems well padded at the base).I am 183cm tall and the fit and comfort of the shoulder straps, and feeling on my back, is fantastic; especially with the laptop providing a little extra structure.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Inateck Travel Backpack – Great Design, Minor Security Concern
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The Inateck Travel Backpack has a practical and well-thought-out design, especially with its 180-degree opening that makes TSA security checks fast and convenient. The material quality is good, and the backpack feels sturdy and durable for travel use.The storage capacity is excellent. The compartments are spacious and well-organized, making it easy to pack clothing, a laptop, and other daily or travel essentials. In terms of functionality and comfort, the backpack meets expectations.However, the main issue is security. The backpack does not have an anti-theft or zip-lock zipper system. Even when using a padlock, the zipper can still be pulled apart slightly, leaving a gap. This was a concern for me, especially when carrying valuables.Because of this security concern, I decided to return the product. Overall, this backpack offers excellent functionality, good build quality, and ample storage space. With improved security features, it would easily be a 5-star product.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Ich bin beruflich 2 Tage am Stück unterwegs (also mit einer Übernachtung). Ob mit Flugzeug oder mit der Bahn ist der Rucksack angenehmer, als ein kleiner Koffer. Da ich vor Ort oft E-Roller nurze ist der Vorteil um so größer. Dank der weichen Struktur lässt er sich, wenn nicht gebraucht, zusammenfalten und platzsparend verstauen, was bei Stadtwohnungen ein großer Vorteil ist. Langzeitreport folgt noch.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: 圧倒的な頑丈さと収納力。5泊の海外出張から日々の出勤までこれ一つで完結！
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: レビュー本文5泊の海外出張と、日々のオフィスへの出勤で使用した感想です。結論から言うと、移動の多いビジネスマンや荷物を一つにまとめたい旅行者にとって、非常に信頼できるバックパックです。【驚くほどの耐久性と素材の強さ】 一番驚いたのは素材の頑丈さです。旅先で見つけたお気に入りのピンバッチを付けようとしたのですが、表面の生地が非常にしっかりしており、針が通りませんでした。1260Dポリエステルのタフさは本物で、中身をしっかり守ってくれる安心感があります。【機内持ち込みに最適なサイズ感】 機内持ち込み可能サイズなのはもちろんですが、ANAやサウスウェスト航空（SW）の座席下のスペースにもしっかり収まりました。足元に置けるので、飛行機の中で必要なものをすぐに取り出せるのが非常に便利です。170cm前後の標準的な男性の体格にフィットするサイズ感だと思います。【重さを感じさせない背負い心地】 5泊分の荷物を詰め込むとかなりの重量になりますが、クッション性が高く、長時間背負っていても肩が痛くなることはありませんでした。荷重分散がうまく設計されていると感じます。【気になった点：本体の重さ】 唯一の注意点は、生地が非常に丈夫な分、空の状態でもそれなりの重さがあることです。軽さを最優先する方よりは、「多少重くても、とにかく丈夫で荷物をしっかり保護したい」という方に向いています。【総評】 圧倒的なタフさと引き換えに本体の重さはありますが、この価格でこのクオリティならコスパはかなり高いです。出張や旅行でのメインバッグとして長く愛用できそうです。

Ich finde Rucksäcke als Reiseutensil sehr praktisch und benutze sie gerne auf Geschäftsreisen. Gut ist, wenn man alles was man für einen Kurztrip benötig in einem Gebinde unterbringen kann und dieses dann auch noch als Handgepäck auf Flugreisen durchgeht. Mit 55x40x21 cm sollte dieser Rucksack bei den meisten Fluggesellschaften problemlos durchgehen. Für das Handgepäck ausgesprochener Billig-Airlines ist er aber zu groß.Apropos groß: Platz bietet der Rucksack wirklich reichlich. Das reicht für - wenn man nicht gerade einen Anzug bügelfrei verpacken will auch für 2-3 Übernachtungen. Ein Notebook mit 16-Zoll nebst Ladegerät und Zubehör findet dann auch noch bequem Platz - es reicht sogar recht locker für mein 17-Zoll LG Gram. Taschen für zusätzliche Accessoires sind im Überfluss vorhanden. Die seitliche Halterung für ein Trinkgefäß ist praktisch, reicht für eine 1 Litzer-Flasche jedoch nicht aus. Für manche Regionen sinnvoll: Geldbeutel, Papiere und sonstige Wertsachen kann man weitgehend Taschendiebstahl-sicher im Rückenteil verstauen.Inwieweit der Rucksack wirklich wasserdicht ist, musste ich glücklicherweise bislang noch nicht ausprobieren. Als Fußgänger hätte ich keine Bedenken, auf eine Fahrrad- oder Motorrad-Reise bei feuchter Witterung würde ich ihn aber lieber nicht mitnehmen.Einen Kritikpunkt habe ich trotzdem: Muss man den Rucksack doch mal schwer beladen über längere Zeit tragen,  von wäre ein verstaubarer Bauchgurt von Vorteil - wie ihn auch andere Rucksäcke bieten.Fazit:Geräumiger und vielseitiger Rucksack für (Geschäfts-)Reisende ohne Expeditions-Ambitionen.

手にした第一印象は｢でかいな！｣機内持ち込み可能な大容量リュックを探していたのでこれは仕方なし。国内旅行、海外旅行一回ずつ利用しました。収納スペースやポケットは必要にして十分。逆に慣れるまでどこに収納したか探すこともありました。大型リュックの場合、上からにもつを入れて行くと小さいもの重いものが下部にたまり、探すのに苦労することがある。これはメイン収納スペースが１８０度開くので探しやすい。ただし脇からこぼれる恐れもあるので、小物を多く収納する際はポーチやサブバックの利用も検討したい。180度開く機能をTSA対応と称するんですね。PC収納スペースやシークレットポケットは今のところ使ってない。機能的使い勝手は今のところ満足してます。
サイズが程よく大きく、防水仕様ともあり大変重宝します。デザインもシンプルで、ビジネスやプライベートで使用出来る。これは買わなきゃ損です。

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Travelled around the World with this bag and this bag only
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I just completed an around the World trip where this was the only bag I took. I was able to fit 3 pairs of pants, 6 shirts, 10 pairs of underwear, my toiletries, sunglasses and a Samsung galaxy 8" tablet.First of all, the bag held up very well with all that travel. Very sturdy and never felt like the zips would break even though they were under some extreme pressure at times.I never once had any difficulties having it accepted as carry on and I flew with Qantas, Finnair, Air Nostrum (small subsidiary of Iberia), British Airways, American Airlines, Westjet, and Japan Airlines.For me it has the right amount of compartments and pockets. If it had more, it would be difficult to locate items in the bag when on flights.I also had to walk long distances with this bag on my back so the strap on the front was vital to help balance the weight. I've suffered from a bad back in the past from backpacks but this bag never strained my back as you can adjust it while you have it on

This bag is great, plenty of room with plenty of pockets.The extendible zip helps when wanting more to pack.Quality seems good. I have used this many time now and no sign of early wear and tear.Happy with this purchase

I bought this bag as I generally catch public transport when travelling and I prefer to be hands free as opposed to wheeling around a suitcase. I absolutely love it, I have packed it to the maximum a few times already using the extendable zipper. I have packed 3 pairs of jeans, sneakers, body products, tops, dresses, a shoebox sized gift and laptop and it fit! The only thing to be weary of is the kg limit as I have packed up to 11kgs in it when the airline limit was 7kgs! I found the straps on my shoulders are comfortable and strong, I pack in a way to ensure the weight is distributed. It also had a water bottle holder which works if your bag isn't packed to the maximum like I do. I love that is had buckle clips in 4 areas so if the zipper ever broke, it would holder the bag together to avoid everything falling out. For the price and weight of an empty bag, I highly recommend it as I can get through the airport really quick as opposed to a wheeled suitcase. I'm 5'2, around 50kgs so yes, it does look very bulky on me but I love it!

Seems very strong and durable, but too heavy. Not practical to carry around for an extended period of time because of its weight and luggage bag type shape. Items move around too much in the main front compartment. It stretches out a lot and can fit a lot of things even without expanding the size. The concealable shoulders are useful but don't give much support.

The only bag I've ever felt safe carrying my gaming laptop in without a case.Isn't soft nor hard framed. Suitcase feature is cool but not a problem in daily life. Smelt like a kids lunchbox but that went away. Super tough outside, I haven't managed to scratch it going in and out of my locker.The drink bottle holder is better as an umbrella holder, because fluids are heavy.It is actually water proof, one of my friends tipped water on it, and it slipped right off.Probably not 55 Litres, but definitely enough for me going to and from for a couple days, doubling as my everyday bag.If they keep making them and keep making them quality, even if it only lasts a year or two (every other bag I've ever owned I've destroyed in 2 at the most), I'll be a lifelong customer.I will say it is a little less comfortable than my other bags I've had when it's got nothing in it, but infinitely more comfortable than them when it's loaded. Go figure.
Had this bag for a while now. Love it. Spacious and good a lot of things you need and want. Couldn't of asked for a better bag than this one.

I've used it on many occasions and it has been versatile, practical and durable. The design makes it great when checking in at airports. Exceptional value when compared to my wife's far more expensive backpack. Never had a problem checking in at airports.
Excellent product. Ticks all the boxes

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Just packing now for a 10 day trip. It unzips to add more room, which is turning out to be necessary. I have the 40-50 size for women. I don't think it will fit under the seat on the plane, but should be ok for the overhead bin. Ends up pretty heavy when fully packed, so will limit my ability to do a lot of walking when I arrive. Maybe for folks younger than my 69 years that might not be an issue. I like the cinch straps on the sides to give an added bit of security and compression. I like the pocket for the shoulder straps; makes it more streamlined for getting on a plane. Like the extra pockets, though I decided to bring a purse to put my iPad, phone and odds and ends and didn't use the outside pockets.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Sturdy, Spacious and Perfect for Travel!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This Haimont large duffle bag exceeded my expectations! The 60L capacity easily fits everything I need for weekend trips, and the separate shoes compartment is super handy. I love that it converts into a backpack- makes carrying it so much easier when traveling or hiking. The material feels strong and durable, with quality zippers and straps. It’s also surprisingly lightweight for its size. Overall, a versatile, well-made bag that’s perfect for travel, gym, or camping. Highly recommend!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: One Bag to Duffel Them All
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’ve used this bag for a couple of gym runs, and it’s proven itself a real workhorse. It swallows gear like a champ, and the convertible design means I can sling it over my shoulders as a backpack or carry it like a duffel. The separate shoe compartment is a lifesaver—keeps muddy boots away from clothes. The material feels tough and water-resistant enough to handle a bit of rough weather without worry.Pros:Huge  capacity, perfect for travel or campingConverts between backpack and duffel easilyShoe compartment keeps dirty gear separateDurable fabric with rugged zipsCons:Can feel bulky when fully packedNo internal dividers for better organisationWould I recommend it?Definitely—if you need a versatile bag that can handle the gym, road trips, or outdoor adventures, this one does it all without fuss.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A Spacious but Underwhelming Duffle Backpack 🎒
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This duffle bag backpack comes solo, no extra accessories 📦.The design is super roomy with a 60L capacity and multiple compartments, making it great for packing all your gear for travel, camping, or sports. It’s got plenty of space and pockets to keep things organized, which is a big win for anyone hauling a lot of stuff 🧳.That said, the look is kinda dull compared to the product images. I was expecting a vibrant pop with bright green zippers, but the real thing blends in with any old backpack, which is a bit of a letdown. It feels sturdy, though, so I’m hoping it holds up well over time 😕.Overall, this backpack is a practical choice for those needing a large, organized bag for trips or activities. It’s not the eye-catcher I hoped for, but it gets the job done for packing and storage 🛤️.

The fabric used throughout this duffle bag is thick, durable and water resistant, and overall, it’s a great looking duffle backpack.  This 60L version is a decent size and ideal for a 3-4 day camp or trip.  The main compartment is spacious and has some internal side pockets, and the opening flap of this main compartment rests against your back when used as a backpack, so nobody can access your gear from behind you.  There’s also a handy top compartment to a large pouch that sits within the main compartment, much like a soccer ball/shoes pocket in sports bags.  On this grey version, the only parts that feel a little cheap are the yellow straps, they’re thinner than you’d expect on an almost $100AUD duffle.  But they’re not crucial to the function of the bag, so it’s not a big deal.  All up, this is a spacious, tough duffle that’s practically designed and the colour of this grey version with the yellow trim will make your bag easily identifiable.

This is a really solid hiking bag that also works great as a duffle or travel bag. What surprised me most was how small it packs down, the straps even clip together to keep it neat, which makes it easy to store or throw in the car when I’m not using it.It’s clearly made with flexibility in mind. The straps are adjustable and removable, so you can set it up how you like. The material feels tough and water-resistant, and I really like the separate shoe compartment, it’s super handy.When it’s loaded up, it’s still comfortable to carry. The design spreads the weight well, so it doesn’t feel like a strain.All up, it’s a durable, roomy, and versatile bag that’s just as useful for hiking as it is for travel.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great quality backpack for camping and day trips
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I recently bought this duffle backpack for a 5-day hiking trip, and it exceeded my expectations. The waterproof, durable material gave me confidence to pack electronics and clothes without worrying about rain or rough surfaces. I especially loved the separate shoe compartment and mesh pockets for organising smaller items like chargers and toiletries. The adjustable straps and chest buckle make it comfortable even when fully loaded. Overall, it’s a versatile, well-built bag that handles travel and daily use with equal ease.

bookDescription: A witty, incisive classic of road-trip literature, from one of the great champions and critics of the American identity'Delightful. This is a book to be read slowly for its savor.' The AtlanticIn 1960, John Steinbeck set out in his pick-up truck with his dog Charley to rediscover and chronicle his native USA, from Maine to California. He felt that he might have lost touch with its sights, sounds and the essence of the American people. Moving through the woods and deserts, dirt tracks and highways to large cities and glorious wildernesses, Steinbeck observed - with remarkable honesty, insight and a humorous eye - the gamut of America and the people who inhabited it.  His 10,000-mile journey took him through almost forty states, where he saw things that made him proud, angry, sympathetic and elated. A rugged and passionate adventure of self-identity, Steinbeck's vision of the changing world still speaks to us prophetically through the decades.

I read and enjoyed this book after it was published in the 60s and enjoyed it then.  I decided to read it again because of the recent controversy engendered by Bill Steigerwald.  I can agree that whilst it may be a work of fiction and not a true travelogue, it is a very interesting read and Steinbeck himself says that it is impressionistic. Similarly it is not a great work of fiction.  What it does give is a view of America and parts of America that we do not neecssarily read about, as it was over fifty years ago, through the author's perspective.  So despite the controversy, I still rate it well and a book well worth reading.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: In Search of America with one's faithful companion
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I first read TRAVELS WITH CHARLEY forty years ago.  I loved it then and I enjoyed it even more the second time around.I have wanted to reread this book for years, and very pleased to obtain a brand new copy of the book at a ridiculously low price.  The online experience of purchasing a book of this kind, which I was unable to obtain from local used bookstores, was rewarding because I did not expect an uncirculated book when I opened the parcel.TRAVELS WITH CHARLEY is as poignant and moving today as it was the first time I read it.  Of course, when I read it the first time, I didn't think twice about the author's comments about his concerns about growing old because as far as I was concerned at the time, he was over the hill - except for his writing.  My second reading brought home to me that Steinbeck was still a relatively young man when he travelled across America with Charley.  His discerning eye and his candid comments about America and Americans are as fresh now as they were then.This time, I had the good fortune to read extensive excerpts from Jay Perini's JOHN STEINBECK: A BIOGRAPHY, 1996(?), after reading CHARLEY - an excellent companion piece that points out a number of variances or discrepancies between some of the politically correct commentary in the book and the letters home and the notes he made from which the book evolved.  As I read Perini's reference to Steinbeck's lament of some of the short-comings of America and Americans -for instance, the great "distraction" of professional sports, I heard the echo of my father's voice who decried the lack of attention to and focus on the real priorities in our World.  I suppose that both Steinbeck and my father were on to something, namely the need to develop and to refine the resources between our ears rather than running rough shod over people and places to develop and to refine the resources below the ground – in America and elsewhere.  Much has changed in America - in the once bustling centres of Ohio and New England, and elsewhere - and I am not sure that America and Americans - and the World are better off for it.For bibliophiles, and anyone who is new to Steinbeck, I highly recommend reading others of his books - THE GRAPES OF WRATH, THE RED PONY and EAST OF EDEN, OF MICE AND MEN AND THE WINTER OF OUR DISCONTENT.  These titles are all available on amazon.ca at reasonable prices.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: A wonderful travelogue through the States with Steinbeck’s eyes.
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: A Wonderful book to discover Steinbeck’s work. It’s a quite honest book. His point of view are quite accurate and objective. If you are familiar with The States, you’ll love Steinbeck’s journey. If you’re not, you’ll discover a different approach to the USA. Even if this travelogue was written in the early 60’s, his opinions and appreciations are quite updated with current times.
Muito bom livro

I love `Travels with Charley: In Search of America', maybe that's because I like travelogues or maybe it's because I love Steinbeck's sublime eloquence, but whatever the reason, this made for one beautiful and captivating read.  Travelling with Steinbeck and his poodle Charley you get to experience a slice of American life that is sadly no more.  You get his usual rich imagery and ability to conjure up a scene in blazing brilliance as he travels across America from New York to California and back again.  I find his style to be immediately comfortable and evocative to read and his descriptions are simple, yet wonderful.  For example, when describing autumn leaves he writes `The climate changed quickly to cold and the trees burst into colour, the reds and yellows you can't believe.  It isn't only colour but a glowing, as though the leaves gobbled the light of the autumn sun and then released it slowly', simply breath taking writing.  This story is all the more endearing as it is mixed in with tales of his relationship with Charley and how they interact together out on the road.  I am a huge fan of Steinbeck and I have to say this sits highly in his body of work.  It is concise, eloquent, descriptive, engaging and a whole host of other words that escape my vocabulary to describe his incredible writing style!  This is a departure from his earlier works, which are based around depression era America and the Salinas valley, but that takes nothing away from the style, skill and story on offer and this comes highly recommended indeed.Feel free to check out my blog which can be found on my profile page.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This 8-piece compression packing cube set has completely changed the way I pack for trips. It makes organising everything in my suitcase so much easier and keeps everything neat and easy to find. Whether I’m using a carry-on or a larger suitcase, these cubes help maximise the space perfectly.The multiple sizes are fantastic because they fit different types of clothing and travel items. I love that the set also includes shoe bags, which helps keep shoes separate from clothes and everything clean. The double zipper compression design is a great feature too, you can expand or compress the cubes depending on how much you’re packing, which really helps save space. They are ultralight yet very durable, so they don’t add unnecessary weight to luggage but still feel strong enough for regular travel. The breathable fabric is another nice touch, helping keep clothes fresh while stored inside.Overall, these packing cubes are practical, well-made, and make travelling so much more organised and stress-free. If you want to pack smarter and keep your suitcase tidy, this set is absolutely worth it.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: I find the new format better for trip planning than the old format
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I backpacked through Europe in the 90's with nothing but a Lonely Planet Europe guide.  It was a life saver!  And for it's time, it was amazing.  But over the past few years I've found myself caring less about pages and pages of restaurants, hotels and places to do laundry, and more about general guidance on what a particular place has to offer and how to make the most of my time there.That's why I think the new format of the Lonely Planet guides is perfect for today... I'm generally always connected to the internet on my trips overseas these days so finding up to date information is easy.  It would be a waste (IMO) to spend half of a guide book describing places and things that might not even be there in a month or year.Instead I think the new format is much better if you're trying to figure out how to maximize your limited travel time making the best memories possible.  I own both the 2021 and 2024 Indonesia guide and I've honestly gotten the most use out of the latter.  I've actually bought a number of other newer Lonely Planet guides for upcoming trips just because I like the new format better!
